name: Title IX Referral of Transgender Student Discrimination Complaints
description: Complaints that could be Title IX discrimination or sex-based harassment against transgender/gender expansive students are referred to the Title IX Coordinator.
quote: Any such complaints or allegations raised under these Administrative Regulations or the accompanying Board Policy that could be construed as an allegation or complaint of Title IX discrimination or sex-based harassment must be referred to the Title IX Coordinator and handled in accordance with the District's Title IX obligations.
